title.en: api3.geo.admin.ch REST API (geocoding, identify, height, profile)

description.de: REST-Dienste der Bundes-Geodaten-Infrastruktur unter api3.geo.admin.ch/rest/services: SearchServer (Geocoding von Orten, Adressen, Layern, Features), Identify-Feature-Abfragen, Höhen- und Profildienst. JSON-Antworten, wählbare Referenzsysteme (LV95, LV03, WGS84, Web Mercator).
description.en: REST services of the Federal Spatial Data Infrastructure at api3.geo.admin.ch/rest/services: SearchServer (geocoding of places, addresses, layers, features), identify feature queries, height and profile services. JSON responses, selectable spatial references (LV95, LV03, WGS84, Web Mercator).
